# Flappy Tappy

Flappy Tappy: Fly Solo or Duel by Chirag Mirani. One-tap ring flying, free endless Solo, live duels of up to 30 seconds and FaceTime play.

Solo works offline. Online duels and FaceTime play require a connection. Other duels: first 100 free, then five per day; one optional purchase enables unlimited duels. App Store ID: 1203310957. No ads or subscription.

- Full iPhone/iPad app: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/flappy-tappy-fly-solo-or-duel/id1203310957
- Marketing page: https://chiragmirani.github.io/through-the-ring/
- Browser Solo preview (a taste of the game, not multiplayer): https://chiragmirani.github.io/flappy-tappy/
- Privacy, including version-specific optional analytics: https://chiragmirani.github.io/through-the-ring/privacy.html
- Support: https://chiragmirani.github.io/through-the-ring/support.html

Verified against the US App Store listing on 2026-11-07. Consult the current listing for releases and local prices.
